items.answer: The exam can be difficult, but not impossible. By attending this course, you will be more than prepared to pass the exam.
items.question: How hard is the Certified Arborist exam?

items.answer: The computer-based exam contains 200 multiple-choice questions. Candidates should review the current ISA candidate guide for complete testing details.
items.question: How many questions are on the Certified Arborist exam?

items.answer: Candidates are given 3.5 hours to complete the Certified Arborist examination.
items.question: How long is the Certified Arborist exam?

items.answer: A scaled score of 76 percent is required to pass the Certified Arborist examination.
items.question: What is a passing score for the Certified Arborist exam?
